scope: continued second-pass inference audit emphasizing omitted cross-source joins, structural bundles, spawn semantics, and predictive progression arithmetic

findings.title: Canonical RNC stream tour order follows progression rows, not player-facing tour order

result.consequence: For all 45 courses, medal/progression tour_row = floor((stream_index - 1) / 5).

findings.falsifier: A runtime course load or progression lookup proving a different named stream identity.

findings.title: Decoded header landmark A.x is the course start/spawn X coordinate at 16-unit scale
findings.falsifier: Direct runtime spawn evidence contradicting the relation on currently matched courses.
findings.next_action: Promote A.x to start/spawn-X semantics with explicit exceptions/provisional Y semantics; investigate Zoom Zoo/Jumps as special-coordinate cases rather than weakening the 43-course relation.

findings.title: Stunt courses have an independent three-signal identity

signals: tour slot = 3 for all 9 stunt streams

findings.next_action: Use the combined signature as a semantic sanity check when course identities are regenerated.

findings.title: Persistent racer state is interleaved P1/P2 at +2 bytes across many fields
findings.next_action: Mine adjacent unknown P1 words for +2 P2 siblings, then validate via marshal readers/writers before naming.

findings.title: Regional WRAM relocation is clustered, not one global offset

result.implication: A single Europe-vs-USA WRAM delta is invalid even inside high-value racer/camera/render state.

findings.next_action: Use anchor/cluster-specific regional mappings rather than arithmetic global relocation.

findings.title: Progression model is now queryable rather than prose-only

result.checksum: medal matrix lies inside 77:05E8..073B protected region; checksum at 77:073C

findings.next_action: Build exact expected SRAM delta oracle before the next real medal-winning acceptance fixture.

findings.title: Racer frame header is a 32-bit occupancy/piece mask

result.implication: Each set header bit strongly predicts one following 16-bit packed piece word.

findings.falsifier: A recovered frame in the same family whose header popcount differs from packed-word count.
findings.next_action: Map packed words to set-bit positions and compare changed bits against changed OAM pieces; this is now a constrained correspondence problem rather than open-format decoding.

findings.title: Historical numeric track IDs map directly to RNC stream ordinals
findings.next_action: Use this mapping when importing old bot/map/script evidence that names only a numeric track ID.

findings.title: Header coordinate pairs are paired racer spawn positions

result.scale: 16 world units per header coordinate unit
result.cross_corpus_pattern: All 36 non-stunt courses have identical A/B X coordinates; A/B Y may differ. Four stunt courses use distinct A/B X coordinates as well.
result.interpretation: The two pairs are strongly predicted to be player-1/player-2 spawn coordinates rather than start/finish landmarks.

findings.falsifier: A second-course runtime initialization showing one header pair does not map to one racer slot.
findings.next_action: Use a course with unequal A/B coordinates as the cheapest direct discriminator; no broad course trace is required.

findings.title: Course resources contain ordered reusable bundles
findings.next_action: Treat each adjacency-preserving group as a structural bundle during resource-semantic mining; inspect descriptor/content relationships before naming the bundle.

findings.title: A one-step medal increment has a rider-parity checksum contribution

result.rule: For a non-saturating +1 medal-cell update, the medal cell contributes +1 to checksum 77:073C for even rider columns and +0x0100 for odd rider columns, modulo 0x10000.
result.limitation: This is the medal-cell contribution; the full award transaction may change other checksum-covered fields.

findings.next_action: Include this predicted checksum contribution in the next medal-winning save/load oracle.

findings.title: Resource bundles are conserved across all four preserved builds

europe_high_level_deltas.switcher: same dimensions/resources; spawn A Y changes 26 -> 22

result.implication: Most PAL-retail course differences lie inside course-local content rather than the high-level resource-selection envelope.

findings.next_action: For regional fidelity, compare decoded fine/coarse course content first on streams 4/16/20/27/35; treat streams 26/36 as the bounded resource-selection exceptions.

findings.title: Semantic-event anchoring is the robust fixture coordinate system

result.strong_fixture_pattern: semantic state wait -> settle/confirm -> event-relative sample tags
result.implication: Absolute guest frame is not a safe universal join key when host presentation can perturb cadence; semantic checkpoints plus relative offsets are.

findings.next_action: When revisiting progression or paired-racer acceptance, add semantic state/event guards before using historical absolute frame offsets as causal evidence.

findings.title: Representative stock camera-strip preparation is same-frame demand-driven

result.horizon: built and consumed in same guest frame during steady rightward Dragster motion

findings.next_action: Do not search for a stock multi-frame prefetch horizon; test deliberately earlier/additional strip scheduling only when Widescreen presentation-state ownership is settled.

findings.title: +8 authentic-center regression is downstream of presentation-ID phase divergence
findings.next_action: Trace P2 presentation-ID selection/update timing and VRAM consequences with full renderer enabled before patching final composition.
